name: Washing Machine Production Line Solution
summary: Full-line automation solutions for washing machine manufacturers, covering the entire process from assembly to packaging.
contentHtml:
The washing machine production line solution is a full-line automation solution provided by TXAM for washing machine manufacturers.

Solution Composition

The full line covers the entire process, including component supply, inner drum assembly, shell assembly, electrical installation, shock absorber installation, online inspection, automatic packaging, and intelligent warehousing.

Technical Advantages

  • High level of full-line automation, reducing manual intervention
  • Flexible switching between multiple models with short changeover time
  • Online inspection system ensures product quality
  • Intelligent data collection enables lean production
  • Integration with MES system for full traceability
  • Turnkey project with one-stop service

Service Content

TXAM provides full-process support from solution design, equipment manufacturing, installation and commissioning to after-sales service.

painPoints.title: Complex Assembly Processes
painPoints.desc: Washing machine assembly involves multiple components with complex processes, making manual assembly difficult

painPoints.title: Long changeover time
painPoints.desc: Long changeover and debugging time during multi-model production affects capacity

painPoints.title: Numerous inspection items
painPoints.desc: Washing machines have many inspection items, and manual inspection is inefficient and prone to missed checks

painPoints.title: Slow logistics turnover
painPoints.desc: Inter-process logistics relies on manual handling, making it difficult to coordinate takt time

painPoints.title: Significant quality fluctuations
painPoints.desc: Inconsistent manual operations lead to unstable product quality

painPoints.title: Difficult data collection
painPoints.desc: Production data is manually recorded, lacking real-time capability and difficult to analyze

process.title: Component supply
process.desc: Automated feeding system enables automatic component supply.

process.title: Inner drum assembly
process.desc: Robots complete precision assembly of the inner drum to ensure dynamic balance

process.title: Outer shell assembly

process.title: Electrical installation
process.desc: Automated wiring systems complete electrical installation such as motors and circuits

process.title: Shock absorption installation
process.desc: Specialized equipment ensures precision installation of the shock absorption system.

process.title: Online inspection
process.desc: Multi-functional test stations complete comprehensive inspections covering performance and safety

process.title: Automatic packaging
process.desc: Automated packaging system achieves efficient, standardized packaging.

process.title: Intelligent inbound storage
